Combine wet

breakfast.name: Flija (Layered Crêpes)
ingredients: Batter: 4 cups flour, 4 eggs, milk, salt, water
Cream: kajmak (clotted cream) or sour cream
instructions: Make thin crêpe batter
In a large round pan (saç), pour thin layer of batter
Bake under heat until set
Spread cream over, pour another layer of batter
Repeat 15-20 layers, baking each under heat
Cut into wedges — the cross section shows dozens of thin layers
Serve warm with yogurt or honey
breakfast.description: Albania's most labor-intensive dish — dozens of crêpe layers baked one at a time under a saç. Made for weddings and celebrations.

breakfast.name: Petulla (Albanian Fried Dough)
ingredients: Feta cheese or honey to serve
instructions: Mix dough, let rise 1 hour
Pull pieces of dough, stretch thin
Fry in hot oil until puffed and golden
Drain and serve with feta cheese or drizzled with honey
breakfast.description: Puffy fried dough — the Albanian doughnut, eaten with salty feta cheese or sweet honey.

instructions: Prepare filling
Layer phyllo
Add egg mixture
Bake

lunch.name: Tavë Kosi
instructions: Brown meat
Add yogurt mixture
Bake until set

lunch.name: Byrek me Mish (Meat Byrek)
instructions: Brown meat with onions
Add diced tomatoes, paprika, salt, pepper
Cool filling, mix in egg
Layer filo sheets in oiled pan, brushing oil between layers
Spread filling over middle layers
Top with more filo layers
Score top into squares
Bake at 180°C for 40-45 min until golden and crispy
lunch.description: The meat version of byrek — Albania's most ubiquitous food. Every bakery sells it from early morning.

lunch.name: Tavë Dheu (Baked Liver)
instructions: Sauté onion and liver in butter
Add grated tomato, paprika, chili, oregano
Transfer to baking dish
Add rice and water
Bake at 180°C for 40 min until rice absorbs liquid
lunch.description: Baked liver with rice — a specialty of Elbasan, often made for honored guests.

lunch.name: Byrek me Spinaq (Spinach Spiral Pie)
ingredients: Filling: 500g spinach (fresh, wilted and squeezed dry), 200g feta cheese, 2 eggs, onion
instructions: Wilt spinach, squeeze out all water — this is critical, wet spinach ruins byrek
Crumble feta into spinach, add eggs, sautéed onion, salt, pepper
Brush each filo sheet with melted butter
Spread spinach filling along one edge
Roll into a log, then coil into a spiral in a round pan
Continue adding logs to the spiral until pan is full
Brush top generously with butter
Bake at 190°C for 35-40 min until deeply golden and flaky
The spiral pattern when cut is the viral visual — layers of crispy filo and green filling
lunch.description: Albania's flaky spiral pie — layers of buttered filo wrapped around spinach and salty feta. The coiled spiral technique and the cross-section reveal went viral. Every Albanian bakery (byrekore) sells these fresh from morning — the smell of butter and filo is the national perfume.

dinner.name: Frikase
instructions: Brown chicken
Add vegetables
Simmer

dinner.name: Tavë Elbasani (Lamb and Yogurt Bake)
instructions: Season lamb, brown in butter
Place in deep baking dish
Beat yogurt with eggs, flour, salt, pepper, oregano
Pour yogurt mixture over lamb
Bake at 175°C for 50-60 min until set and golden on top
Center should be custardy, edges slightly puffed
dinner.description: Albania's most famous baked dish — lamb under a golden yogurt custard. Named for the city of Elbasan.

dinner.name: Speca të Mbushur (Stuffed Peppers)
ingredients: Filling: 400g ground beef, 1 cup rice, 1 onion, tomato paste, parsley, mint, salt, pepper
instructions: Hollow peppers, keep tops
Cook rice halfway, mix with browned meat, onion, herbs, tomato paste
Stuff peppers, replace tops
Stand in baking dish, pour tomato sauce around
Bake at 180°C for 40-45 min
Serve with crumbled feta on top
dinner.description: Stuffed peppers — made across Albania, each family with their own filling recipe.

dinner.name: Fergese Tirane (Baked Pepper and Cheese)
instructions: Roast peppers, peel and chop
Make roux with butter and flour
Add chopped tomatoes, cook 10 min
Add peppers and crumbled cheese
Pour into baking dish, crack eggs on top
Bake at 200°C until eggs set and top is golden
dinner.description: Tirana's signature dish — roasted peppers, tomato, and cheese baked with eggs. Simple and rich.

snacks.name: Qofte të Fërguara (Fried Meatballs)
instructions: Mix meat with grated onion, squeezed bread, egg, herbs, spices
Shape into flat oval patties
Fry in oil until browned on both sides
Serve with yogurt and fresh bread
snacks.description: Spiced meat patties — found at every Albanian restaurant and family table.

snacks.name: Trilece (Three Milks Cake)
ingredients: Sponge: 6 eggs, 1 cup sugar, 1 cup flour
Milk soak: evaporated milk, condensed milk, cream
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar until very thick and pale
Fold in flour gently
Bake sponge at 175°C for 25 min
Poke holes all over warm cake
Mix the three milks, pour over
Refrigerate overnight — the cake absorbs everything
Make dark caramel, pour over top before serving
snacks.description: Albania's beloved tres leches — soaked in three milks, topped with dark caramel. Found in every pastry shop.

desserts.name: Baklava
instructions: Layer phyllo
Add nut mixture
Bake
Add honey syrup

desserts.name: Kabuni (Sweet Rice with Raisins)
instructions: Melt sugar in butter until caramelized
Add lamb broth, bring to boil
Add rice, raisins, spices
Cook covered until rice absorbs liquid
Mold into dome shape, invert onto plate
Serve warm — often alongside roast lamb
desserts.description: Sweet spiced rice from Elbasan — traditionally molded into a dome and served at celebrations.

desserts.name: Sheqerpare (Syrup Cookies)
ingredients: Cookies: 250g butter, 2 cups flour, 1 cup semolina, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 eggs, baking powder
Syrup: 2 cups sugar, 2 cups water, lemon juice
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs
Mix in flour, semolina, baking powder
Shape into small balls, press an almond into each
Bake at 170°C for 18-20 min — should stay pale
Make syrup: boil sugar and water with lemon juice
Pour hot syrup over warm cookies
Let soak for several hours — cookies become moist and glossy
desserts.description: Syrup-soaked butter cookies — Ottoman heritage found across Albanian pastry shops.

drinks.name: Turkish Coffee
instructions: Heat water
Add coffee and sugar
Simmer
Serve

drinks.name: Raki (Albanian Grape Spirit)
instructions: Ferment grape pomace or crushed grapes
Distill in copper alembic
Often distill twice for smoother spirit
The clear spirit should be 40-50% ABV
Serve in small glasses at room temperature
drinks.description: Albania's national spirit — homemade by nearly every family with a vineyard. Offered to every guest who walks through the door.

drinks.name: Boza (Fermented Grain Drink)
instructions: Cook corn flour or millet into a thin porridge
Cool to room temperature
Let ferment 2-3 days until slightly tangy and thick
Sweeten with sugar
Serve cold, sprinkled with cinnamon
drinks.description: Thick, sweet, slightly fermented grain drink — Ottoman heritage, drunk during winter months.
